functions.name: addFlare
functions.description: Adds a Flare observability stack to the application model: an OTLP ingest service (the returned resource), the query API, the alert worker and the dashboard. Containers are used for local development. The default images are , , and , all with the tag .
functions.signature: addFlare(name: string, clickhouse: ClickHouseServerResource, redis: RedisResource, dashboardPort?: number): FlareResource

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the resource. This name will be used as the connection string name when referenced in a dependency.

parameters.name: clickhouse
parameters.description: The ClickHouse server Flare stores its telemetry in. Flare adds its own database to it.

parameters.name: redis
parameters.description: The Redis instance Flare uses to buffer telemetry before it is written to ClickHouse.

parameters.name: dashboardPort
parameters.description: The host port for the Flare dashboard.

functions.name: connectionStringExpression
functions.description: Gets the connection string expression for the ingest service: the OTLP/gRPC URL, for example `http://localhost:4317`.

functions.name: otlpGrpcEndpoint
functions.description: Gets the OTLP/gRPC endpoint of the ingest service (port 4317 by default).

functions.name: otlpHttpEndpoint
functions.description: Gets the OTLP/HTTP endpoint of the ingest service (port 4318 by default).

functions.name: withApiKey
functions.description: Requires an API key on the ingest service. OTLP clients must send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, for example through `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS=Authorization=Bearer <key>`. Resources wired with `WithOtlpExporter``1` send it automatically.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: The parameter holding the API key.

functions.name: withDataVolume
functions.description: Persists Flare's identity database in a shared volume
functions.remarks: ClickHouse and Redis keep their own data volumes; configure them on those resources.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the volume. Defaults to a name derived from the application and resource name.

functions.name: withFlareImageTag
functions.description: Sets the image tag of all four Flare containers (ingest, API, alert worker and dashboard).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The image tag, for example `0.6`.

functions.name: withFlareOtlpExporter
functions.description: Points a resource's OpenTelemetry exporter at a Flare ingest service by setting `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` and `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL`.

parameters.name: flare
parameters.description: The Flare resource builder.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: The OTLP protocol to export with. `Grpc` uses the ingest service's gRPC endpoint; `HttpProtobuf` and `HttpJson` use its HTTP endpoint.

functions.name: withIngestPorts
functions.description: Sets the host ports of the ingest service's OTLP endpoints. By default they are the conventional 4317 (gRPC) and 4318 (HTTP).

parameters.name: grpcPort
parameters.description: The host port for OTLP/gRPC, or `null` to leave it unchanged.

parameters.name: httpPort
parameters.description: The host port for OTLP/HTTP, or `null` to leave it unchanged.

functions.name: withPublicUrls
functions.description: Sets the URLs a browser uses to reach the query API and the dashboard. By default these are the loopback addresses of the local containers, which only works when the browser runs on the same machine. Set them when the stack is published and reached through other hostnames.

parameters.name: apiUrl
parameters.description: The parameter holding the public URL of the query API, or `null` to leave it unchanged.

parameters.name: dashboardUrl
parameters.description: The parameter holding the public URL of the dashboard, or `null` to leave it unchanged. The query API uses this value verbatim as its allowed CORS origin, so it must be an origin only: `scheme://host[:port]`, with no path and no trailing slash (for example `https://flare.example.com`).
